messages.text: Looked up for Sarah: NerdQaxe++ $249, 150W — about $17/month power at 16¢. US and EU plugs out of stock, ~30-day lead; BC04 is 6 TH/s at 100W, $249, shipping now.

Hey, I'm Sarah! At about sixteen cents the BSB NerdQaxe++ costs around $17 a month to run. It's $249, and it draws for a full block every ten minutes. Would it run on a desk, or somewhere out of the way? Tap an answer, or the mic and tell me.
Garage or out of the way
Looked up for Sarah: In a garage the NerdQaxe's quieter 45 dB edge doesn't matter — the BC04 is same 6 TH/s, same $249, 100W (~$11/month), in stock now.

A garage is perfect for it. The Hammer BC04 also does six terahash, runs about twelve dollars a month, and ships now, while the NerdQaxe is about a month out. Want to compare them?
